name: New Holgha
description: New Holgha was a terrestrial planet in the Outer Rim Territories' Ciutric sector, known for its Five Holy Cities. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, it was easily conquered by the extragalactic invaders after the New Republic, believing Mandalorian intelligence on the upcoming attack to be untrustworthy, relocated New Holgha's defense force elsewhere.
